info.title: Engineering Development Hub (EDH) API
info.description: API specification for EDH (formerly Scale Out Computing on AWS - SOCA). Add api/doc?ui=swagger or api/doc?ui=rapidoc to change UI provider.

post.description:
Renew (extend) the expiration of the specified token by the policy's default
lifetime. Renewal is subject to the token being marked renewable, admin policy
allowing renewals, and the max_renewals limit not being reached.

parameters.name: token_id
parameters.description: ID of the token to renew

403.description: Token is not renewable or max renewals reached or renewal disabled by policy

404.description: Token not found or does not belong to the caller

get.description: Returns the full admin-configured token policy. Requires admin (sudo) privileges.

put.description:
Merge-updates the token policy. Only the fields provided in the request body
are updated; unspecified fields retain their current values. Requires admin
(sudo) privileges. Changes take effect immediately for new token operations.

max_tokens_per_user.description: Maximum number of active tokens per user

max_lifetime_hours.description: Maximum token lifetime in hours (up to 1 year)

default_lifetime_hours.description: Default token lifetime when not specified by user

max_renewals.description: Maximum number of renewals per token

renewal_allowed.description: Whether token renewal is allowed globally

require_expiration.description: Whether all tokens must have an expiration

global_deny.description: Paths blocked for all scoped tokens. Keys are path patterns (prefix with /api/, suffix with * for wildcard). Values are arrays of HTTP methods.

get.description: Returns the admin-configured token policy that governs token creation, lifetime, and renewal limits. Read-only for non-admin users.

max_tokens_per_user.description: Maximum number of active tokens per user

default_lifetime_hours.description: Default token lifetime when not specified

max_renewals.description: Maximum number of times a token can be renewed

renewal_allowed.description: Whether token renewal is allowed globally

require_expiration.description: Whether tokens must have an expiration

global_deny.description: Paths that are denied for all scoped tokens

get.summary: Query the token API audit log
get.description:
Returns paginated audit log entries for scoped token API usage. Supports
filtering by user, token_id, path, method, status, and time range.
Requires admin (sudo) privileges.

parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return

get.summary: List all active tokens across users

Returns the .dcv connection file (as text/plain attachment)
